title: dry-eyes probes
description: Persisted repo profile + duplication-probe set, written once by /dry-eyes init and reused by every /dry-eyes scan — the deliberate counterpart to a security-audit skill's lenses.json: a PROBE configures a cheap deterministic signal (collect-signals.sh), it doesn't investigate anything itself. Profiling a repo and naming its duplication-prone categories is repo-shape work, done once, not per-run work. Plain, editable JSON — if a category is missing, add one by hand and re-run scan; no need to re-run init.

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp, from the init session's own context.

gitRev.description: git rev-parse HEAD at design time — profiling reasons about the repo AS OF this commit; a repo that has changed substantially since should re-run init.

packages.description: Every package/workspace the profiling pass found — informs config.json's scopes, but is not the same list (this is richer analysis, config.scopes is the actual, user-editable scan-target list).

sharedModulePaths.description: Existing shared/common module locations — used to suggest a repo-idiomatic 'canonical home' for a cluster's proposed consolidation, instead of a generic 'extract a helper'.

duplicationHypotheses.description: Repo-shape observations from the profiling pass, e.g. "these two directories look like mirrored product lines" — cheap for an LLM to state from directory names and manifests alone, and empirically found to reliably point at real clusters. Seeds category design; not itself a finding.

existingCloneTooling.description: Any jscpd/PMD-CPD/similar config already present in the repo. If non-empty, category design should deprioritize categories whose duplication would be plain textual copy-paste — that tool already finds those.

conceptCategories.description: The duplication-prone categories designed for THIS repo (validation rules, monetary calculations, error/notification UX patterns, ...) — repo-specific, not a generic fixed list. Each seeds signal parameters (domain words, mechanism patterns) AND, in 'thorough' mode, an LLM inventory-sweep prompt that catches duplication sharing no surface signal at all.

id.description: Slug, used in signal parameterization and report grouping.

focus.description: One line: what concept this category is about.

domainWords.description: Feeds signals.nameFamily's gating for this category. Without this, name-family clustering is dominated by framework conventions (call/initialize/perform) — verified empirically.

mechanisms.description: Feeds signals.concernMechanism, if this category represents a 'concern' with multiple possible implementation mechanisms (e.g. error display via toast vs. inline state vs. flash message).

pattern.description: ERE pattern (no backreferences — must work with both ripgrep's and grep -E's engines).

expectedSharedHome.description: If this concept were factored out once, where would it live in THIS repo? Derived from sharedModulePaths. Turns a cluster's recommendation into repo-idiomatic prose instead of a generic 'extract a helper'.

inventoryPrompt.description: Complete, standalone brief for an independent subagent's inventory sweep in 'thorough' mode: what to grep/read for this category across the whole scope, and what to return (an INVENTORY of occurrences, not duplicate claims — that's a later pipeline stage's job).
